_comment: Study parameters. NOT hardcoded anywhere -- pilot exists to change these, and every logged event carries this file's hash so any session's actual values can be recovered from the log alone. See docs/预注册_pre-registration.md PR-6. Values below are pre-pilot defaults, not final.

organization._comment: Hard time limit. The participant sees a countdown (红线 #4 permits it here and only here).

generation._comment: Not timed. The participant waits while the letter is assembled.

verification._comment: Timed silently for the moderator only. NO soft lock: the participant declares completion themselves, which is the behaviour being measured. target_seconds is what the schedule assumes; hard_cap_seconds is when the moderator should intervene, not when the software locks.

probe._comment: PR-2. Algorithm is pre-registered; these are its parameters.

session._comment: Told to participants and used to set compensation. Longer than the sum of the phases because verification is not hard-locked.

integrity._comment: PR-4. ±3σ only flags for human review; invalidation is the separate loss rule.

sample._comment: PR-5. B is an optional arm: build C to 24 first.
